scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Eh! Can't and old man walk in peace anymore?!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哎！現在連老頭子都不能安安靜靜散個步了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Eh? whats that?!
 
My wife wants me home?! Alright, alright... I'm going, I'm going. Thank you for telling me the message.
 
Here take this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯？你說什麼？！

我老婆叫我回家？！好好好... 我這就回去。
謝謝你來傳話。

給，拿著這枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Kieth]
Sorry can't talk, I'm a busy man, I'm waiting for my package.
scripts.translation:
[基斯]
抱歉，沒空聊天，我忙著等包裹呢。

scripts.text:
[Kieth]
Weren't you supposed to deliver me a box? Where is it?
scripts.translation:
[基斯]
你不是應該給我送個箱子嗎？在哪兒呢？

scripts.text:
[Kieth]
Ahh, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Agency. Do you have my bow??
 
Ahh, good,thank you for your time. Take this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation:
[基斯]
啊，你是尋寶獵人公會派來的吧？
我的弓帶來了嗎？

太好了，謝謝你跑這一趟。
給你一枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Billy-Bob]
Arrrg!... Those Bastard Bugs have eaten everything, this place doesn't even look like my farm anymore!!
scripts.translation:
[比利鮑勃]
啊...！那群該死的蟲子吃光了所有東西，這裡看起來都不像我的農場了！！

scripts.text:
[Billy-Bob]
Ohhh, thank you thats a good start for me.
Well those bugs can bugger off...
 
Well here take these 2 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[比利鮑勃]
哦，謝謝，這下總算能重新開始了。
那些蟲子終於可以滾蛋了...

給你兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Billy-Bob]
Those Bastard Bugs are Everywhere!!!
You must be from the guild! OK, bring me 20 Worm Peelings, 20 Jellopies, 20 fluff and 20 Clovers.
scripts.translation:
[比利鮑勃]
該死的蟲子到處都是！
你是公會派來的吧？
給我帶 20 個蟲皮、20 個傑勒比結晶、20 個絨毛和 20 個三葉草。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
This is my husbands grave... I'm just paying him a little visit.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
這是我丈夫的墳墓...我只是來陪他說說話。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
You have them?!
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
你帶來了？！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Thank you sooo much here have these 3 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
真是太感謝了，給你三枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
So your the one that has come to help me?
 
Ok well this is what I wanted you to do, this greave beside me is my husbands grave and I promised him that I would bury some Mementos with him, The problem is that I have no Mementos...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
你就是來幫我的人吧？

旁邊就是我丈夫的墳墓。
我答應過他，要放一些紀念品陪著他。
可是... 我手頭一件也沒有...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Bring me 15 Mementos, please.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
請給我帶 15 個紀念品。

scripts.text:
[Erika]
Hello my name is Erika.
scripts.translation:
[艾麗卡]
你好，我叫艾麗卡。

scripts.text:
[Erika]
What's that? You have a letter for me!!
Oooooh I just love,love letters :D. next here will I open it.
scripts.translation:
[艾麗卡]
什麼？你有信要交給我？！
哦，我最喜歡情書了 :D。
快讓我拆開看看。

scripts.text:
[Letter]
Dear Erika
 
Sorry to inform you but you have been evicted, please move out within 3-5 days.
 
-Management
scripts.translation:
[信件]
親愛的艾麗卡：

很遺憾地通知您，您已被要求遷出，請在三至五天內搬離。

-管理方

scripts.text:
[Erika]
Oh... um... Well fuck, that bastard thinks he can kick me out!!!!! He's got another thing coming!
 
Well thank you for delivering this anyway have this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation:
[艾麗卡]
哦... 嗯... 媽的，那個混蛋居然想把我趕出去！
他做夢！

不管怎樣，謝謝你送信來，拿著這枚尋寶代幣吧。

scripts.text:
[Erika]
So your the one that has a letter for me?
 
Ok well where's the letter?
scripts.translation:
[艾麗卡]
原來你是給我送信的人？

好吧，信在哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Jeramiah]
Its so boring when you have to next on people...
scripts.translation:
[傑拉邁亞]
等人真是無聊...

scripts.text:
[Jeramiah]
Ahh hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
Do you have my Jur? Ahh good good. Thank you.
Here have this Treasure Hunter Token.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉邁亞]
啊，你好，你是尋寶獵人公會派來的吧？
我的刺擊拳刃帶來了嗎？
很好，很好，謝謝。
給你一枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Jeramiah]
So your the one that is supposed to bring my Jur?
So where's my Jur?
scripts.translation:
[傑拉邁亞]
你就是來送刺擊拳刃的人吧？
那我的刺擊拳刃呢？

scripts.text:
[Lenith]
Hello, sorry I don't have much time to talk I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation:
[萊尼斯]
你好，抱歉，我沒太多時間聊天，我在等人。

scripts.text:
[Lenith]
Oh hello, OH you have my honey, my bees and I thank you.
 
Here have these 2 Treasure Hunter Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[萊尼斯]
哦，你好！我的蜂蜜帶來了啊。
我和我的蜜蜂都很感謝你。

給你兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Lenith]
Hello, my name is Lenith and I have a quest for you.
Well recently a bunch of stupid bears stole the supers off all my bee's nests...Stupid bears.
 
What I need you to do is find me some more honey so these bee's can get through the winter. I will need about 20 Honey.
scripts.translation:
[萊尼斯]
你好，我叫萊尼斯，有件事需要你幫忙。
最近一群蠢熊偷走了我所有蜂箱的儲蜜箱... 該死的熊。

幫我再找些蜂蜜吧，讓這些蜜蜂能熬過冬天。
大約需要 20 個蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Molly]
Sorry can't talk, I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation:
[莫莉]
抱歉，沒法聊天，我在等人。

scripts.text:
[Molly]
WOW YOU DID IT!!!
 
I knew you looked strong, I have no idea how you could have killed that monster though.
thank you so much, here have these 3 Guild Tokens as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[莫莉]
哇，你做到了！

我就知道你很強，不過實在想不出你是怎麼打敗那隻魔物的。
太感謝了，給你三枚尋寶代幣作為獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Molly]
Wow you must be the brave man from the treasure hunter guild!
Ok here is whats happening, I don't know what started it but there is a strange Ronan Skeleton running around the woods 2 East from here.
scripts.translation:
[莫莉]
哇，你就是尋寶獵人公會派來的勇士吧！
不知道出了什麼事，從這裡往東兩張地圖的樹林裡，有個奇怪的邪骸浪人在四處遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Molly]
We have try to kill him in the past but it was not...ummm...It was a bad idea. What I want you to do is go there and bring me back his Skull as proof of you killing him.
 
Good Luck
scripts.translation:
[莫莉]
我們之前也試過消滅他，可是... 嗯... 結果很糟。
請你過去，把他的頭骨帶回來，證明你已經打敗了他。

祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Clark]
Love to chat, but I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation:
[克拉克]
很想聊天，但我在等人。

scripts.text:
[Clark]
Ok well this is a start.
 
I hope that this hole will go away 1 day, and I might have another quest for you in the future.
here take these 2 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[克拉克]
好，總算有點進展了。

希望那個洞有一天能消失。
以後也許還有別的任務要請你幫忙。
給你兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Clark]
Well hello to you.
You must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
 
Ok well this is my problem, yah see that hole in the ground? Yah that thing just popped out of nowhere a couple years ago, inside its full of these ugly ants and these monsters called Giearths.
scripts.translation:
[克拉克]
你好，你是尋寶獵人公會派來的吧？

看到地上那個洞了嗎？
幾年前突然冒出來的，裡面滿是醜陋的螞蟻，還有叫基爾瑟的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Clark]
What I want you to do is kill some of the Giearths.Bring me 30 of there little Moustaches.
scripts.translation:
[克拉克]
幫我消滅一些基爾瑟，帶回 30 個鼻毛。

scripts.text:
[Flank]
Sorry I'm waiting for my package so I don't want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
抱歉，我在等我的包裹，所以不想聊天。

scripts.text:
[Flank]
Perfect right on time, now I must be going to plant this bomb.... Err I mean give this package to my mother for her birthday.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
太好了，來得正是時候。
我得去安放炸彈了... 呃，我是說，把這個包裹送給媽媽當生日禮物。

scripts.text:
[Flank]
Thanks
Have this Treasure Token
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
謝謝。
給你一枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Flank]
So you have my packages?
Well where is it then?
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
所以你有我的包裹？
那它在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Sewer Management]
Live doesn't get any worse for me, working in this bug filled Culvert every day...
scripts.translation:
[下水道管理員]
天天在滿是蟲子的下水道里幹活... 日子真是糟透了。

scripts.text:
[Sewer Management]
Well that looked like it was no trouble for you.
Thanks have these 4 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[下水道管理員]
看來這對你來說不算什麼難事。
謝謝，給你四枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Sewer Management]
For a while now we have had monster, mostly bugs infesting the culvert...
 
What I want you to do is kinda clean some of it out, every little bit counts.
Bring me 150 Worm Peelings.
scripts.translation:
[下水道管理員]
下水道被魔物佔據有一陣子了，主要都是蟲子...

幫忙清理一些吧，能少一隻是一隻。
給我帶回 150 個蟲皮。

scripts.text:
[Rudolfo]
Danger, the Coal Mine is now a hostile area.
scripts.translation:
[魯道夫]
危險！煤礦現在到處都是敵人。

scripts.text:
[Rudolfo]
Well its good to see that you have come back alive.
I had my doubts but thank you for your help.
 
Here have these 4 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[魯道夫]
你能活著回來，真是太好了。
雖然一開始我有些擔心，還是謝謝你幫忙。

給你四枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Rudolfo]
Hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
 
They must have filled you in on what is happening on the lower levels of this Coal Mine, I know its disturbing and we are still trying to figure out why and how 2 Evil Druids got down there.
 
Well what I want you to do is bring me 50 Lantern's as proof that you have cleaned some of them out, any loot you find down there you may keep other then what I have asked you to get for me.
scripts.translation:
[魯道夫]
你好，你是尋寶獵人公會派來的吧？

他們應該告訴過你煤礦下層的情況了。
確實很令人不安，我們還在調查那兩隻暗神官為什麼會在那裡，又是怎麼進去的。

請帶回 50 個燈籠，證明你已經清理掉一部分魔物。
除了我要求的物品，其他戰利品都歸你。

scripts.text:
[Flora]
Well hello be careful in the cave, we have heard reports of Undead monster funning around.
scripts.translation:
[芙羅拉]
你好，進洞要小心。
聽說裡面有不死魔物在四處遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Flora]
Welcome back, good job you did it. (I wonder if that Flaming Bastard is still alive)
Well I hope that cut down a bit on the monsters and here have these 2 Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[芙羅拉]
歡迎回來，幹得好！
（不知道那個火焰混蛋還活著沒有...）
希望魔物能因此少一些，給你兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Flora]
Well hello there.
 
Well this is what I need you to do, bring me 50 Decayed Nails - a while back Payon Cave used to be a safe place to go...But now things have gone out of control and Zombies have invaded the first floor...
 
There is also these new monsters that have just popped out of no were, we call them Flaming Bastards...Be careful if you aren't powerful yet because they are very strong.
scripts.translation:
[芙羅拉]
你好。

請給我帶回 50 個亡者指甲。
斐揚洞穴以前挺安全的... 可現在情況失控了，第一層到處都是腐屍...

還有一些不知道從哪兒冒出來的新魔物，我們叫它們火焰混蛋...
它們很強，要是你實力還不夠，可得小心。

scripts.text:
[Flora]
Good Luck
Remember I need 50 Nail's
scripts.translation:
[芙羅拉]
祝你好運。
記住，要 50 個亡者指甲。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Get out of my face you flake.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
從我眼前滾開，你這個廢物。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Dear god took you long enough you bastard!
You know how much my time is worth!!!!
Your slow and I'm never gonna recommend a job for you, Gimmie my staff and get out of me face!
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
天哪，磨蹭這麼久，你這個混蛋！
你知道我的時間有多值錢嗎？！
這麼慢，以後別想讓我介紹工作給你！
把我的法杖拿來，然後滾！

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Well you can take this crappy Treasure Token.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
拿著這枚破尋寶代幣吧。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Where's my staff?
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我的法杖呢？

scripts.text:
[Dassy]
Hello!
scripts.translation:
[達西]
你好！

scripts.text:
[Dassy]
Yes! Now my pet will not starve!
Thank you so much!
Have this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation:
[達西]
太好了！我的寵物不會餓肚子了！
謝謝你！
給你一枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Dassy]
Hello person!!
You have come to help me? Yes, yes.
 
Ok I don't want to talk about it but I need you to fine me 20 Shoot's
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[達西]
你好呀！你是來幫我的吧？

事情我不想多說，不過請幫我找 20 個嫩芽。
謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Czhore]
Hello friend
Have you come to check out one of these guild halls?
scripts.translation:
[茨霍雷]
你好，朋友。
你是來參觀公會大廳的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Czhore]
Thank god!
 
I'm so happy to see one of these Emperiums! Thank you {0}.
scripts.translation:
[茨霍雷]
謝天謝地！

終於見到華麗金屬了，我太高興了！
謝謝你，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Czhore]
Here have these 2 Treasure Tokens.
And some of my old treasure...
scripts.translation:
[茨霍雷]
給你兩枚尋寶代幣，還有一些我以前收藏的寶物...

scripts.text:
[Czhore]
Hello friend
I know this may sound stupid but ever since I was a boy I have dreamed of having an Emperium...
As I know I look old, I have just never been able to find one, now that I am retired from the Treasure Hunter Guild there is no more action for me...
 
If you can get me one I shall reward you.
scripts.translation:
[茨霍雷]
你好，朋友。
說來可能有點傻，我從小就夢想著擁有一塊華麗金屬...
如今已經這麼老了，卻始終沒找到。
現在我從尋寶獵人公會退休了，也沒機會再出去冒險...

你要是能替我找來一塊，我一定酬謝你。

scripts.text:
[Lithin]
Well hello.
Welcome to the Forest Maze.
scripts.translation:
[莉辛]
你好。
歡迎來到迷藏森林。

scripts.text:
[Lithin]
Oh thank you so much, but they will be back...
scripts.translation:
[莉辛]
哦，非常感謝你，但它們還會回來的...

scripts.text: Take these 2 Treasure Tokens
scripts.translation: 拿著這兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Lithin]
Well hello.
Welcome to the Forest Maze, I have a task for you.
 
Ever heard of a monster called a Savage? It looks like a boar but it makes very annoying noises.
What I want you to do is bring me 15 Manes from the savages.
scripts.translation:
[莉辛]
你好，歡迎來到迷藏森林。
我有件事要請你幫忙。

聽說過野豬這種魔物嗎？
長得像野豬，叫聲卻吵得要命。
請從它們身上收集 15 個鬃毛給我。

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Much thanks I have for you.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
非常感謝你。

scripts.text: Take with you these 2 Treasure Token's.
scripts.translation: 拿著這兩枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Must do for me you shall.Venture through the Pyramid.
When second floor you have reached,slay skeletons of evil.
Bring me back there bones you must.
It is 30 that I desire.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
一件事，要你替我做。
金字塔，你要深入。
第二層到了，邪惡的骷髏，你要消滅。
它們的骨頭，帶回來給我。
30 個，是我所需。

scripts.text:
[Blond Girl]
I wonder what happened to my flowers
scripts.translation:
[金髮女孩]
不知道我的花怎麼樣了。

scripts.text:
[Blond Girl]
Oh are these my flower! To bad I don't want them anymore...
 
You can keep them is you want.
scripts.translation:
[金髮女孩]
哦，是我的花！可惜我已經不想要了...

你喜歡的話，就留著吧。

scripts.text:
[Blond Girl]
Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[金髮女孩]
給你一枚尋寶代幣作為獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Blond Girl]
Hello, did you bring me flowers!?!
scripts.translation:
[金髮女孩]
你好，你帶花兒給我了嗎！？

scripts.text:
[Wizard]
Hello, have you seen my Whisper friend?
scripts.translation:
[巫師]
你好，你見過我的白幽靈朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wizard]
Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.
scripts.translation:
[巫師]
謝謝你幫忙，恐怕最壞的情況已經發生了。

scripts.text:
[Wizard]
Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[巫師]
給你四枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text:
[Wizard]
Hello, the reason why I brought you here was because of a long time ago I made a friend, which happened to be a Whisper.
He told me that he was always bullied by the other ghosts down there and I haven't seen him in a while.
Thinking of the worse case here, I want vengeance!
 
Bring me 50 Fabrics!
scripts.translation:
[巫師]
你好，找你來是因為我很久以前交過一個朋友，它是隻白幽靈。
它說下面的其他幽靈總是欺負它，我也有一陣子沒見到它了。
如果真的出了什麼事，我要替它報仇！

給我帶回 50 個布料！

scripts.text:
[Thief]
Welcome to the Thieves Guild.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊]
歡迎來到盜賊公會。

scripts.text:
[Thief]
Thank you for this delivery.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊]
謝謝你把貨送來。

scripts.text:
[Thief]
Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊]
給你一枚尋寶代幣作為獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Thief]
Where's my delivery?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊]
我的貨呢？

scripts.text:
[Strange Man]
Another quest for you I have.
Further into the pyramid you must go.
Fighting Mummies is future for you.
 
Bring back for me their wrappings you must.
It is 30 Rotten bandages I desire.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的男子]
另一個任務，我還有。
金字塔深處，你要前往。
木乃伊，你將與之戰鬥。

它們的裹屍布，帶回來給我。
